offering_description.value: Operates education and training programs for students, professionals and institutions, sells and services vehicles through dealerships, and provides home health and hospice care. It manufactures electrical components, treated wood and industrial equipment for business customers, and operates local television stations that sell advertising and carriage rights. Its consumer businesses include custom framing, restaurants and digital publishing.

primary_products.value: new and used vehicles; electrical components and assemblies; fire-retardant-treated wood; industrial lifting and motion equipment; custom picture frames

primary_services.value: education and professional training; vehicle maintenance and repair; home health and hospice care; television broadcasting and advertising; restaurant dining

customer_segment.value: B2C: Students, test takers, working professionals, car buyers, home health and hospice patients, framing customers, diners and readers; B2B: Universities, employers, vehicle fleet buyers, equipment makers, building-material suppliers, advertisers and pay-TV operators

end_markets.value: education and workforce training; automotive retail and service; home health and hospice care; industrial manufacturing and construction; local media and advertising

revenue_model.value: service fees: Tuition, test preparation, vehicle repairs and restaurant dining; project or contract: Education delivery and student support for universities and employers; product sales: Vehicles, electrical components, treated wood, industrial equipment and custom frames; healthcare reimbursement: Home health and hospice services paid by Medicare and other insurers; advertising: Television airtime and digital ad placements; licensing or royalties: Local television retransmission rights paid by cable and satellite operators; commissions or management fees: Arranging vehicle financing and selling third-party protection products; subscription: Paid access to digital publications and member content
revenue_model.category: service fees; project or contract; product sales; healthcare reimbursement; advertising; licensing or royalties; commissions or management fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses instructors, course materials and clinicians to deliver education and home-based care to learners, institutions and patients; retailer: Sources vehicles from manufacturers and the used-car market for sale to drivers and fleet buyers; OEM / manufacturer: Turns lumber, electrical parts and metals into products for building suppliers and equipment makers; asset operator: Runs local broadcast stations that air programming for viewers and sell airtime to advertisers; other: Produces and publishes digital editorial content for readers and advertisers
value_chain_position.category: service provider; retailer; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; other

geography_served.value: global: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Singapore and other international education markets

specialization.value: diversified: Education, automotive dealerships, home health and hospice, industrial manufacturing, local television, custom framing, restaurants and digital publishing

distribution_channels.value: online: Course enrollment and delivery platforms, dealership websites, custom framing orders and digital publications; direct sales: University and employer contracts, healthcare admissions, industrial account teams and station advertising sales; own locations: Teaching centers, auto dealerships, framing shops and restaurants; partners / resellers: University partners, healthcare referral networks and cable and satellite carriers; distributors / dealers: Building-material distributors and industrial equipment dealers; other: Over-the-air television broadcasts and in-home clinical visits
distribution_channels.category: online; direct sales; own locations; partners / resellers; distributors / dealers; other

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Education authorization and accreditation, state healthcare licensing, Medicare certification, FCC broadcast licensing and state motor vehicle dealer licensing.

notes: The current roster and relative scale of the smaller manufacturing and digital media businesses are uncertain.
